title: Harden engine input validation found in review
description: Follow-up from the TASK-1.2, TASK-1.3 and TASK-1.4 security reviews (non-blocking MINORs). Engine entry points accept a few malformed inputs that a later caller (playtest CLI, session layer, saved data) could pass in.

nodes.title: Harden engine input validation found in review
Bootstrap the strict TypeScript project with one-command checks
Rank showdown hands by real poker hand rankings
Deal every hand from a seeded shuffle with a replay code
Play a complete fixed-limit hand from blinds to showdown
Run every check in GitHub Actions on each push and pull request

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given parseCard is called with a non-string or a string longer than 3 characters, When it rejects the input, Then it throws a typed error whose message echoes at most 10 characters of the input
Given createHand with any stake or stack that is not a safe integer, When the hand is created, Then it is rejected with the existing invalid-config error
Given createHand has returned, When the caller mutates the stakes or seats objects it passed in, Then the hand state is unchanged

Given nextIntUnbiased(n), When n is outside the range for which it is exactly unbiased, Then it either throws RangeError or is exactly unbiased for that n, and its doc comment states the supported range
